{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (should be 6, but found 0)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders found:", qa_orders.shape[0])

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Refunded orders:", refunded.shape[0])"}
